C0748.title: Guilin Bank Credit Card Mini-Program Flagged for Privacy Compliance Violations
keywords: National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center
C0748.summary: In June 2026, the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center reported 71 non-compliant applications.
